verdict.rationale: Factory publishes an API reference section, such as the Sessions endpoints for creating and driving Droid sessions, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at docs.factory.ai/openapi.json. That establishes a structured, spec-backed reference. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run in the browser. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground experience, runnable request examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API reference experience.
